Transmittance (T)
Transmittance

______ are used to determine the concentration of unknown substance.
Standard curves
Standard curves are used to determine the concentration of unknown substance.
______ is a solution of a particular pH that can resist pH changes on the addition of acid or alkali.
buffer
A buffer is a solution of a particular pH that can resist pH changes on the addition of acid or alkali.

weak acid
A weak acid is a better buffer because it does not dissociate completely but the strong acid dissociate completely.

standard curve

laboratory

______ is a technique involving the determination of the amount of light that is transmitted or absorbed by a substance at a given wavelength.
Spectrophotometry
